title: FiGO OCR failing on printed receipts from a specific retail chain
description: Expense receipts from Migros stores are consistently failing FiGO OCR recognition. The receipt data is not being extracted - amount, date, and merchant fields show empty. Receipts from other retailers work fine. We have been manually entering Migros receipts for two weeks.

worklogs.description: Analyzed sample Migros receipts. They use a narrow thermal print format with text compressed to 35 characters per line. FiGO OCR profile for Turkish retailers does not have a pattern for this narrow format.
Created a new OCR extraction pattern for Migros narrow-format receipts. Mapped field positions for amount, date, VAT, and merchant.
Tested new pattern against 10 sample Migros receipts - all extracted correctly.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hello, I analyzed the Migros receipts you shared. They use a compressed narrow-format thermal print that is different from other major Turkish retailers. The FiGO OCR engine recognizes receipt formats using pattern templates, and the Migros narrow format does not have a template in the current library. I am adding a new OCR pattern for Migros receipts. I will need a few sample Migros receipts to calibrate the pattern - could you share 3-4 photo samples? Both old and recent receipts would be...

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Attaching 5 Migros receipts from different dates. Two from this month, two from last month, and one from three months ago.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Thank you for the samples. I built and tested the new Migros OCR pattern. All 5 sample receipts extracted correctly - amount, date, VAT breakdown, and merchant name all captured. I have deployed the new pattern to your FiGO instance. Please test by uploading a Migros receipt through the normal expense flow.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Just tested with a new Migros receipt - all fields extracted correctly on the first try. Great. Can we also check BIM and A101 receipts? I have heard some colleagues have issues with those too.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: BIM and A101 are in the standard Turkish retailer template library so they should work, but I will test both. If you can share one or two sample receipts from each, I can confirm and add patterns for any that are missing.

resolutionNote: Migros receipts use a compressed narrow thermal print format not covered by the FiGO OCR template library. Created and deployed a new OCR pattern for Migros narrow format receipts. All fields (amount, date, VAT, merchant) now extract correctly.

csat.comment: Problem that was annoying us for two weeks solved in one day.
